inspection_summary: Fresh inspection covered all 3,006 normalized splitlines from title page through bibliography. The source is a broad advanced survey whose reusable depth lies in its repeated movement among divisor geometry, analytic continuation, functional equations, prime-zero transforms, local-global factorization, and the analytic limits of increasingly general L-function constructions. Formula extraction is often degraded but the surrounding prose usually fixes the intended mechanism; the two plot pages are separately marked extraction-defective. There are no prior v1 units to carry or repair.

accepted_units.title: Symmetric infinite products turn zero geometry into coefficient identities
accepted_units.why_material: The sine product shows how convergence-respecting symmetry converts a known divisor into Newton-sum identities, while the DL definition isolates the geometric prerequisite and links a one-line divisor to reflection symmetry.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the product regrouping, coefficient comparison, the non-real-zero caveat, and the precise DL formulation; the converse is explicitly deferred.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-heavy product and power-series extraction; checked prose makes the mechanism recoverable despite lost typographic detail.

accepted_units.title: Gamma turns factorial interpolation into divisor factorization
accepted_units.why_material: Gamma simultaneously interpolates factorials, supplies a prescribed pole divisor, factors the sine complement, and illustrates why low-order symmetric holomorphic interpolation can be rigid across scalar domains.
accepted_units.context_note: The p-adic remark is only a forward pointer; the accepted claim is the interpolation/divisor bridge established here.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on the gamma limit, Weierstrass product, and complement formula; prose and displayed identities are legible enough for semantic use.

accepted_units.title: Divisor-preserving exponential factors limit naive Newton reconstruction
accepted_units.why_material: Multiplying by an exponential changes Taylor data without changing zeros, showing why divisor information alone does not determine coefficient identities; finite-order/minimality constraints motivate the source's transalgebraic heuristic for otherwise unsafe limiting algebra.
accepted_units.context_note: The Transalgebraic Principle is explicitly a guiding heuristic, not a theorem, and its exponential example is illustrative.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Uses a power-series perturbation and a symbolic infinite-degree limit; retain the heuristic status and do not literalize the infinities.

accepted_units.title: Euler factors are rescaled sine divisors, but infinite products need arithmetic control
accepted_units.why_material: Unique factorization creates the Euler product; each local factor has a vertical divisor and sine-like form, motivating a local-to-global DL conjecture while the text explicitly warns that arbitrary infinite products do not preserve it and cites a non-Eulerian failure case.
accepted_units.context_note: The conjecture is source-labeled imprecise and the Davenport-Heilbronn comparison bounds its intended scope.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The local-factor divisor/frequency formulas are extraction-sensitive but supported by clear prose.

accepted_units.title: Logarithms isolate the prime-frequency term from a controlled remainder
accepted_units.why_material: Taking logs of the Euler product separates the prime sum from higher powers whose remainder stays bounded near one, so the zeta pole transfers divergence to the reciprocal-prime sum.
accepted_units.context_note: This is an analytic strengthening of infinitude, not a prime-number-theorem argument.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on absolute convergence and the displayed logarithmic series; OCR slightly compresses one inequality but the prose fixes it.

accepted_units.title: A Hankel contour removes the Mellin integral's half-plane restriction
accepted_units.why_material: The Mellin representation is converted into a contour integral entire in the parameter; contour deformation reconnects it to the original integral, gamma reflection exposes the candidate poles, and monodromy/Cauchy cancellation leaves only the simple pole at one.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes path-class independence and pole/residue control needed for a coherent continuation mechanism.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Strongly contour- and formula-dependent; the path description and prose are usable, but a scan should be consulted for exact formula transcription.

accepted_units.title: Local expansion at zero converts continuation into Bernoulli values and trivial zeros
accepted_units.why_material: The Bernoulli generating series inserted into the contour representation makes negative-integer values coefficient extractions, separating rational special values from forced real trivial zeros.
accepted_units.context_note: Specific numeric examples are supporting checks; the reusable mechanism is coefficient extraction from a local expansion.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Several displayed fractions are degraded, but the generating-function and residue logic are stated clearly.

accepted_units.title: Residues at the contour lattice produce the first functional equation
accepted_units.why_material: Closing the contour in a region of decay converts the Hankel integral into residues at a regularly spaced lattice, whose sum is zeta at the reflected argument; gamma normalization then yields the functional equation and transports special values.
accepted_units.context_note: The initial real-part restriction is part of the derivation and continuation supplies the global identity.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Residue computation is formula-heavy and exact constants should be scan-checked before symbolic reuse.

accepted_units.title: Completion converts a meromorphic equation into an entire zero symmetry
accepted_units.why_material: Gamma duplication/reflection and a symmetric pole-killing factor define the order-one entire xi function, turning the functional equation into an involution and forcing nonreal zeros into conjugate/reflected orbits within the critical strip.
accepted_units.context_note: The unit distinguishes completion, pole removal, and zero symmetry from the stronger critical-line claim.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Completion factors are extraction-sensitive; the invariant equation and prose description are reliable.

accepted_units.title: Theta modularity transfers through Mellin splitting to zeta symmetry
accepted_units.why_material: Poisson summation gives theta inversion; splitting the Mellin integral at the self-dual point and changing variables creates an expression invariant under parameter reflection, providing a second route to the same completion and a Fourier-cosine representation.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a representation-transfer mechanism, not merely a duplicate proof; it anticipates modular L-functions.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Requires theta, Mellin, and change-of-variable formulas; exact final kernels should be checked against the PDF.

accepted_units.title: Zero-count asymptotics and sampled real zeros do not supply the missing critical-line proof
accepted_units.why_material: The source separates Riemann's zero-count asymptotic, finite computations, partial later lower bounds, and the stronger assertion that every zero is on the line, preserving the gap between density evidence and totality.
accepted_units.context_note: Historical attribution is reported as the source's account; the semantic value is the evidence hierarchy.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The asymptotic formulas are partially degraded but their roles and the quoted claim are clear.

accepted_units.title: Functional symmetry makes the critical line the minimal DL configuration
accepted_units.why_material: Once completion and Euler factors live in a divisor-on-lines setting, reflection symmetry permits paired vertical lines, while the strongest one-line configuration is forced to be the critical line; this compresses RH into a minimal-divisor heuristic.
accepted_units.context_note: The source presents support, not proof, and explicitly couples it to the speculative transalgebraic principle.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Primarily prose with simple geometric line symmetry; low representation risk.

accepted_units.title: Zero real parts control prime-counting oscillation size
accepted_units.why_material: Each nontrivial zero contributes an oscillatory prime-counting term whose magnitude is governed by its real part, yielding an error estimate equivalent to RH and tying zero-free regions to asymptotic accuracy.
accepted_units.context_note: The straight log-zeta/prime-counting integral is included as local setup; exact best-known constants are not the point.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Displayed big-O and integral formulas are legible in role but should be scan-checked for exact exponents.

accepted_units.title: Logarithmic differentiation equates prime powers with the completed zero divisor
accepted_units.why_material: Euler-product differentiation produces von Mangoldt weights, while Hadamard factorization of the completed function produces reciprocal distances to zeros; equating them yields the prime-zero identity that powers later explicit formulas.
accepted_units.context_note: The pairing of symmetric zeros is essential for convergence and is retained in the span.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Highly formula-dependent; semantic correspondence is clear, exact normalization needs source-image verification.

accepted_units.title: Möbius sign cancellation reformulates RH but resists half-plane improvement
accepted_units.why_material: The reciprocal Euler product encodes square-free parity in Möbius coefficients, suggesting cancellation strong enough for continuation to the half-plane, but the source records that even a weaker convergence improvement remains unavailable.
accepted_units.context_note: This is an obstruction-calibrated equivalent route, not evidence that random-sign intuition suffices.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on a standard reciprocal series and summatory estimate; OCR preserves the conceptual content.

accepted_units.title: Prime powers become a positive step measure adapted to Mellin inversion
accepted_units.why_material: Log zeta naturally weights prime powers by reciprocal multiplicity; the resulting step function has a Mellin/Fourier-Laplace transform, and Möbius inversion recovers ordinary prime counting.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes jump normalization and transform variable so later inversion is locally coherent.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dense but supported by explicit prose descriptions of jumps, weights, and inversion.

accepted_units.title: Integration by parts makes zero-factorization compatible with transform inversion
accepted_units.why_material: Direct substitution of the logarithmic zero product is divergent, so an integration-by-parts regularization permits termwise inversion and decomposes prime counting into a smooth term, trivial corrections, and zero-driven oscillations; controlling the latter is the unresolved step.
accepted_units.context_note: The span includes the discontinuity/nonuniform-convergence warning and distinguishes suggested asymptotics from proved error bounds.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Exact explicit-formula constants and pairing conventions are extraction-sensitive; use for mechanism unless scan-verified.

accepted_units.title: A smooth prime approximation can be striking yet fail as an exact predictor
accepted_units.why_material: Ramanujan's Möbius-corrected logarithmic-integral approximation is reported as numerically false in its strongest reading, motivating a weaker recurrence/density question and illustrating how impressive local accuracy can coexist with unmodeled zero oscillations.
accepted_units.context_note: The Ramanujan-set conjecture is the author's proposal, not established evidence.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The approximation formula is readable; quoted historical wording is contextual rather than a mathematical premise.

accepted_units.title: Zero exponentials distinguish prime-power frequencies from generic frequencies
accepted_units.why_material: Riemann/Landau explicit formulas show enhanced noncancellation exactly at prime-power frequencies; Cramer's exponential sum packages the same resonance into meromorphic continuation with singularities tied to logarithms of primes.
accepted_units.context_note: The result is presented under its stated summation convention and asymptotic regimes.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Some inequalities and constants are OCR-risk; the prime-power versus non-prime-power dichotomy is textually explicit.

accepted_units.title: A symmetric contour becomes a Fourier-Poisson distribution and positivity criterion
accepted_units.why_material: Evaluating a log-derivative contour by residues and by Euler/functional-equation boundary terms yields explicit formulas; distributional test functions unify them, and Weil's reformulation converts RH into positivity on a suitable function class.
accepted_units.context_note: Positivity is an equivalent criterion within the named setup, not an independently proved route.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The Delsarte distribution formula is visually degraded; the contour and positivity mechanism is recoverable from prose.

accepted_units.title: Explicit and trace formulas share a divisor-frequency architecture
accepted_units.why_material: Selberg, noncommutative, and zeta-regularized trace viewpoints are presented as instances of a common transformation between spectral/divisor data and geometric or Dirichlet frequencies, motivating Poisson-Newton rather than a literal physical identification.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a structural analogy with multiple interpretations, not evidence that any proposed trace space exists for zeta.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Mostly prose; low formula dependency.

accepted_units.title: Poisson-Newton interpolates between Newton identities and Poisson summation
accepted_units.why_material: For a finite-order meromorphic Dirichlet series, the Newton-Cramer distribution of its divisor is equated with atoms generated by logarithmic Dirichlet frequencies; one-frequency and polynomial specializations recover Poisson and Newton, while zeta and Selberg specializations recover explicit and trace formulas.
accepted_units.context_note: The text stresses that no functional equation is required, separating divisor-frequency duality from reflection symmetry.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Definitions of multi-indices and distribution coefficients are formula-heavy; exact notation should be image-checked for implementation.

accepted_units.title: Inverse Laplace of the logarithmic derivative extends Newton relations beyond Dirichlet series
accepted_units.why_material: Replacing discrete Dirichlet data by the inverse Laplace transform of f'/f extends the divisor identity to finite-order meromorphic functions and reinterprets Gauss's gamma integral as continuous-exponent Newton relations.
accepted_units.context_note: The distribution supported at zero records the Hadamard exponential factor and must not be discarded.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Exact distributional coefficients are extraction-sensitive; prose identifies their structural role.

accepted_units.title: Pair correlation agreement underdetermines a Hilbert-Polya mechanism
accepted_units.why_material: Montgomery's normalized spacing law and GUE agreement are separated from the much stronger existence of a Hermitian operator; the source offers a shared Fourier kernel as an alternative explanation and treats numerical confirmation as statistical, not causal, evidence.
accepted_units.context_note: The pair-correlation theorem carries the assumptions stated by the source; the Fourier explanation is the author's interpretation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The limiting density is formula-dependent, but the evidential distinction is clear in prose.

accepted_units.title: Prime-orbit trace matching exposes both a shared formalism and a sign obstruction
accepted_units.why_material: Substituting a formally divergent Euler product into the zero-count fluctuation aligns prime logarithms with periodic-orbit periods and amplitudes, yet a divergent sign and absence of a natural system block literal identification; Poisson-Newton offers a broader common explanation.
accepted_units.context_note: The computations assume RH and are perturbative/formal, which is essential to the unit's caution.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Trace formulas are severely extraction-sensitive; only the prose-supported correspondence and mismatch are safe without scan verification.

accepted_units.title: Unnormalized zero differences encode low zeros as repulsion deficits
accepted_units.why_material: Histograms of all zero differences, rather than only normalized neighbors, are reported to show a hierarchy of uniformity, Montgomery behavior, and deficits at existing zero locations, suggesting translation-invariant global rigidity.
accepted_units.context_note: This is numerical observation with the source's interpretation; the intervening plots are not themselves machine-readable evidence.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Relies on figure-backed computation; prose is recoverable, but quantitative claims require original plot/data verification.

accepted_units.title: Mating distinct L-function zeros points to product-character divisors
accepted_units.why_material: Cross-differences between zeros of distinct Dirichlet L-functions place deficits at zeros of the product character and local-factor pairings recover local poles, a pattern the source argues is algebraic-arithmetic rather than same-spectrum quantum correlation.
accepted_units.context_note: The claimed exact reconstruction is reported computationally and needs independent data validation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The character example is partially formula-dependent; the cross-family mapping is clearly stated in prose.

accepted_units.title: The eñe-product turns local root multiplication into global divisor convolution
accepted_units.why_material: A second product on rational Euler factors forms a commutative ring and extends primewise to arithmetic Dirichlet series; its divisor behavior predicts why cross-L-function zero differences locate the divisor of a product-character L-function.
accepted_units.context_note: The global divisor convolution may fail to be discrete and the source flags it as subtler than the finite-factor construction.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Factor/root formulas are OCR-risk; the ring laws and primewise lifting are prose-supported.

accepted_units.title: A unit equation converts an off-line zero into a forbidden product zero
accepted_units.why_material: The source uses the eñe-product unit equation to argue heuristically that an off-critical zero would induce a zero in a half-plane where the product identity has none, illustrating how a new algebra on L-functions could constrain divisors.
accepted_units.context_note: Explicitly retain the source's warning that arithmetic eñe-products are subtler; this is not a proof of RH.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The zero-location arithmetic and normalization are extraction-sensitive and require scan verification before formal use.

accepted_units.title: Adelic Fourier-Mellin analysis puts finite and infinite primes on one footing
accepted_units.why_material: Ostrowski's places, restricted idèles, factorized test functions, and local Fourier-Mellin transforms reconstruct finite Euler factors and the archimedean gamma factor uniformly; global Fourier duality then explains the completed functional equation and the need for the infinite place.
accepted_units.context_note: The speculative interpretation of s(s-1) is excluded; the accepted span ends with the product-formula/compactification viewpoint.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Notation for measures and restricted products is formula-heavy but accompanied by sufficient prose for conceptual interpretation.

accepted_units.title: Greater L-function generality tends to reduce available analytic control
accepted_units.why_material: The survey explicitly organizes the zeta universe as increasing structural scope paired with diminishing knowledge of continuation and other analytic properties, and hypothesizes that a successful mechanism should extend beyond one function.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a source-grounded organizing hypothesis, not a taxonomy or proof requirement.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-only; no representation dependence.

accepted_units.title: Conjugate pairing restores a self-functional equation for complex characters
accepted_units.why_material: Character multiplicativity yields the Euler product, parity fixes the gamma factor, and a non-real character's L-function is paired with its conjugate so the product has self-duality and a union divisor, allowing the generalized critical-line statement without pretending each factor is individually real analytic.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the arithmetic zero-location application at s=1 and distinguishes quadratic from general characters.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Root-number and completion constants are extraction-sensitive; the conjugate-pair mechanism is clear.

accepted_units.title: Dedekind zeta packages ideal factorization and global invariants into analytic data
accepted_units.why_material: Unique ideal factorization gives local Euler factors; completion reflects real/complex embeddings, while the residue at one encodes class number, regulator, roots of unity, and discriminant, showing how a zeta singularity carries arithmetic structure.
accepted_units.context_note: The later Hecke/idèle generalization is included only as the stated local-global extension.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The exact completion formula appears OCR-suspect, so constants must be verified before reuse; the encoding relation is explicit.

accepted_units.title: Artin local factors are natural algebraically but analytically unusable without transfer
accepted_units.why_material: Frobenius actions define characteristic-polynomial local factors in arbitrary representations, but continuation and functional equation are recovered only by reducing characters to one-dimensional/known zeta cases, demonstrating bridge construction as a substitute for direct Euler-product analysis.
accepted_units.context_note: The source's stated reduction to Dedekind/Hecke functions bounds the claim; no general Artin holomorphy is asserted.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Local determinant notation is extraction-sensitive but fully described in prose.

accepted_units.title: Finite-field point counts become rational cohomological zeta data
accepted_units.why_material: Frobenius-periodic point counts define a generating zeta function; the Weil package links rationality, duality, absolute-value bounds, and Betti degrees, and cohomology turns the polynomials into Frobenius actions so geometric positivity can prove the local RH bound.
accepted_units.context_note: The unit stays within the finite-field/local setting and records which components were proved by which structural advances only as source context.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Several exponent and factor formulas are degraded; use the conceptual Frobenius/cohomology/duality chain unless scan-verified.

accepted_units.title: Local rational RH does not resolve global transcendental Euler products
accepted_units.why_material: Multiplying finite-field local factors across rationally independent prime frequencies creates a genuinely transcendental Hasse-Weil function; the source sharply distinguishes success on rational/periodic local models from the analytic continuation and divisor problem of the global product.
accepted_units.context_note: The assessment of Deligne's relevance is the author's methodological judgment, but the local-versus-global distinction is textually concrete.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Mostly prose with Euler products; low risk for the scope distinction.

accepted_units.title: Automorphic local representations propose a universal L-function package but not its analytic proof
accepted_units.why_material: Finite-place polynomial factors, archimedean gamma parameters, contragredient symmetry, and Langlands generation give a broad structural container, while the source emphasizes that an Euler-product definition alone does not deliver continuation.
accepted_units.context_note: The grand RH statement is conjectural and the presentation is explicitly sketchy.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Completion conventions are formula-sensitive; the structural package and bottleneck are clear.

accepted_units.title: Hecke eigenvectors turn modular transformation laws into Euler products
accepted_units.why_material: Modular symmetry supplies analytic continuation and reflection, while simultaneous Hecke eigenstructure enforces coefficient multiplicativity and hence an Euler product, exhibiting the dual analytic-arithmetic input missing from bare Euler-product definitions.
accepted_units.context_note: The span includes definitions needed to connect cusp behavior, eigenoperators, coefficients, and the completed L-function.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Operator sums and exact gamma normalization are OCR-risk; the construction chain is prose-supported.

accepted_units.title: Maass and higher-rank forms replace holomorphy with invariant spectral data
accepted_units.why_material: Laplacian eigenfunctions, Fourier-Bessel coefficients, and commuting Hecke operators reproduce Euler products and functional equations without holomorphic modular forms, then Iwasawa/higher-rank structure generalizes the same pipeline to degree-n local factors.
accepted_units.context_note: Higher-rank Rankin-Selberg properties are described as weaker or more formal, preserving the analytic limitation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Fourier expansions and gamma factors are degraded; safe use is conceptual unless compared with the scan.

accepted_units.title: Symbolic dynamics makes periodic-orbit zeta rational by trace enumeration
accepted_units.why_material: Fixed-point counts define dynamical zeta; a finite Markov transition matrix gives counts as traces of powers and sums them to a determinant, while hyperbolic Markov partitions extend the combinatorial mechanism up to boundary redundancy.
accepted_units.context_note: The unit explains why this rationality is a finite-coding phenomenon and hence a limited analogue for transcendental zeta functions.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Core trace/determinant identities are legible; geometric partition details are prose-supported.

accepted_units.title: The Selberg class packages four recurring constraints without explaining their origin
accepted_units.why_material: Analyticity, Ramanujan coefficient growth, completed reflection, and controlled Euler factors are isolated as a compact interface for a conjectural RH domain, summarizing recurring requirements across prior families.
accepted_units.context_note: The source notes that a wider non-Dirichlet class may exist; these axioms are a proposed class, not a permanent ontology.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Several parameter inequalities are formula-dependent but enumerated clearly.

accepted_units.title: Kummer-compatible special values define p-adic zeta branches
accepted_units.why_material: Congruences among Bernoulli special values make residue-class-restricted sequences converge p-adically; removing the local Euler factor yields analytic branches interpolating complex zeta values in a new scalar domain.
accepted_units.context_note: Parity and p=2 exceptions are retained; the construction is interpolation, not a functional-equation argument.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Limit and interpolation formulas are OCR-risk in signs/exponents; exact implementation needs scan verification.

accepted_units.title: Current evidence types support plausibility but not total zero control
accepted_units.why_material: The source separately discounts finite computation, partial critical-line proportions, weak off-line density, algebraic/dynamical toy models, and spectral analogy as insufficient for the universal claim, offering a reusable audit against overinterpreting proxy success.
accepted_units.context_note: The author's beliefs and rhetoric are not accepted as mathematical evidence; only the explicit limitations are retained.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-only; no formula dependency.

accepted_units.title: The central bottleneck couples continuation beyond convergence with rigid prime frequencies
accepted_units.why_material: The source locates the analytic difficulty in making Eulerian information act inside the critical strip and the arithmetic difficulty in rational independence of prime frequencies; perturbing those frequencies is used to argue that either ingredient alone misses the target.
accepted_units.context_note: The Beurling perturbation statement is heuristic as phrased and the broad historical judgments are not independent evidence.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: One frequency-product display is degraded; the two-factor decomposition is explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Candidate proof ingredients must join structure, positivity, global Euler data, and Fourier analysis
accepted_units.why_material: The concluding synthesis demands a larger analytic-algebraic structure, a positivity pairing, a globally meaningful proxy for the Euler product in the critical strip, and Fourier/complex analysis that retains arithmetic information.
accepted_units.context_note: These are conjectured ingredients inferred by the author, not acceptance criteria for a proof or settled architecture.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-only; no formula dependency.

accepted_units.title: Gamma identities are recovered from divisor, order, and normalization
accepted_units.why_material: The appendix shows a reusable entire-function method: determine poles/zeros and order, use Weierstrass factorization, then fix the exponential ambiguity by asymptotic or normalization to obtain reflection and multiplication identities.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Divisor geometry from local factors to the critical line
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The source repeatedly derives reflection constraints from divisor geometry and treats RH-type statements as minimal vertical-line configurations across local and completed settings.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: DL preservation under arithmetic infinite products is conjectural, and finite-field multi-line results do not establish the global transcendental case.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Two functional-equation routes and their local-global generalization
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Contour residues and theta/Mellin modularity provide distinct zeta routes that reappear as adelic Fourier duality and modular-form transformation laws.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Shared symmetry does not by itself locate zeros; exact normalization and kernels are formula-sensitive.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Prime-zero duality as transform inversion
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Logarithmic differentiation, Mellin/Fourier inversion, and Poisson-Newton all express one architecture in which prime-power frequencies and the zero divisor are dual descriptions.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Convergence, summation conventions, and distributions at zero are essential and prevent naive termwise identities.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Trace analogies need not imply a literal spectrum
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Explicit, random-matrix, semiclassical, and dynamical trace formulas can share Fourier/divisor-frequency structure without producing a canonical Hilbert-Polya operator.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This explains formal similarity but neither excludes every spectral realization nor proves RH.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Local algebraic success versus global transcendental difficulty
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Rational local or finitely coded zeta functions permit algebraic, cohomological, or combinatorial control that does not survive the infinite product over independent prime frequencies.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The comparison is methodological and does not deny that local theories may supply techniques or analogies.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Analytic-control ladder across L-function families
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: As definitions move from explicit analytic representations toward general Euler products, continuation becomes the bottleneck; bridges to modular, Hecke, or spectral realizations restore analytic control.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The sequence is a survey lens, not a complete hierarchy or proof that every useful L-function must be automorphic.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Divisor statistics motivate a second multiplication
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Within the source, cross-zero repulsion patterns motivate an eñe-product whose primewise root multiplication predicts additive relations among global divisors.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The observations are computational, global divisor convolution may be nondiscrete, and the RH consequence remains heuristic.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Interpolation changes domains while preserving arithmetic samples
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Gamma and zeta special values illustrate how discrete arithmetic data can determine analytic objects over archimedean or p-adic domains when growth or congruence constraints supply rigidity.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The rigidity hypotheses differ substantially; this is a structural comparison, not one uniform theorem.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: A source-specific bottleneck and proposed response
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Proxy evidence fails because RH needs simultaneous control of analytic continuation and rigid arithmetic frequencies; the author therefore anticipates a larger structure joining positivity, global Euler information, and Fourier analysis.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: These are strategic hypotheses distilled from the survey, not observed proof progress or an authorized architecture.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Entire-function normalization controls exponential ambiguity
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Across sine, xi, gamma, and Poisson-Newton, divisor data becomes determinate only after order, symmetry, or normalization accounts for the exponential factor invisible to zeros.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Exact uniqueness conditions vary by function and must not be collapsed into a single unrestricted divisor principle.

within_source_saturation: Saturated for quota-free semantic segmentation after inspecting every splitline: all substantive sections contribute either a selected mechanism or bounded supporting context, while the unselected remainder consists predominantly of navigation, repeated historical detail, routine examples/algebra, two extraction-defective plot pages, motivational advice, and bibliography.
